title: New upgrade broke high values
symptom: After updating, values above 300 show up as a low 30. For example, 319 on Freestyle Libre shows as 31. Everything above 270 shows up as 27 (low).
cause: The issue is caused by a numerical overflow due to values beyond the 12-bit coding. The 13th bit was removed from the calculation, causing high values to wrap around and appear as low values.
fix: Enable the 13th bit mask in xDrip settings: Settings -> Less Common Settings -> Calibration Settings -> use 13 bit ads mask. Alternatively, use another algorithm as described in LibreOOPAlgorithm. The 13bit mask mode is enabled by default in the latest nightly.
evidence_quote: Due to very bad lack the 13 bit was removed from the calculation therefore the numbers got smaller again. @KevinDenys What you can immediately do is 1) return to use the 13'th bit  2) use another algorithm for calculating bg. To return the 13'th bit do: in xDrip settings->less common settings->calibration settings->use 13 bit ads mask.
